text: {"name":"llc_desc_ring_enqueue","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates an incoming LLC descriptor against a per-channel context, enqueues it into a hardware command ring with 4-byte-aligned size accounting, programs the associated HW control registers, decrements the per-channel outstanding counter, and recycles the source descriptor.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v5":"src_desc","v6":"chan_ctx","v8":"cmd_ring","v9":"ctrl_ctx","v10":"ring_slot_ptr","v11":"hw_reg_base","v12":"prev_len_byte","v14":"aligned_len","v15":"word_count","v16":"total_xfer_len","v17":"ctrl_reg_read","v18":"prev_seq_num","v20":"status_word","v21":"new_seq_num","v22":"next_desc","v23":"cfg_ptr"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":82,"meaning":"desc validity/ready flag bit (bit 0)"},{"offset":68,"meaning":"per-channel context pointer in a1"},{"offset":324,"meaning":"ctrl_ctx pointer back-ref in chan_ctx"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"hw_reg_base pointer in ctrl_ctx"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"ring_slot array base in cmd_ring (uint16_t*)"},{"offset":32,"meaning":"ring read pointer in cmd_ring"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"ring write pointer in cmd_ring"},{"offset":9,"meaning":"status/command word in src_desc (bit fields 19-22 = length/type)"},{"offset":17,"meaning":"next-descriptor or back-link field in src_desc"},{"offset":40,"meaning":"cumulative byte offset in chan_ctx"},{"offset":10,"meaning":"sequence number (uint16_t) in chan_ctx"}]}
